source: 外研社选择性必修第三册 Unit 2 同主题完形(摄影社/祖父修怀表/学书法/手艺纪录片/学陶艺/手工礼物)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Joining the Photography Club
passages.text: Last autumn I joined the school photography (1)____. At the first meeting, our teacher said that a camera is only a (2)____; the real art lies in how you look at the world. She asked us not to (3)____ about expensive equipment, but to practise every day with whatever we had. My first photos were (4)____ — blurred, dark and badly framed. Yet I did not give (5)____. Slowly I learned to wait for the right (6)____, when the sun was low and soft. I also began to (7)____ ordinary scenes that I had never paid attention to before, such as an old woman selling flowers. My teacher often (8)____ us that patience matters more than luck. By winter, my pictures had clearly (9)____, and I felt proud of every small (10)____ I had made.

passages.title: Grandfather's Pocket Watch
passages.text: My grandfather kept an old pocket (1)____ that had stopped working years ago. One winter evening, he decided to (2)____ it himself at the kitchen table. He opened the tiny back cover and looked at the (3)____ wheels inside with a magnifying glass. "Each part must be cleaned with great (4)____," he told me softly. For hours he worked, his hands moving slowly and (5)____. I was amazed that he never lost his (6)____, even when a spring jumped out and rolled across the floor. At last he (7)____ the cover and gently wound it. To my (8)____, the old watch began to tick again. Grandfather smiled and said that fixing it was like bringing a small friend back to (9)____. That night I learned that (10)____ and care can repair almost anything.

passages.title: Learning Calligraphy
passages.text: When I was ten, my mother sent me to learn Chinese (1)____. My first teacher was a patient old man who wrote beautiful characters with a soft (2)____. He told me that good writing needs a calm (3)____ and a steady hand. At first my lines were (4)____ and ugly, and I wanted to quit. But the teacher asked me to (5)____ the same stroke again and again until it felt natural. "Skill grows through (6)____ and error," he often said. Day by day, my characters slowly became more (7)____. I learned to sit up straight, breathe slowly, and (8)____ fully on each line. After two years, I could write a whole poem that I was (9)____ of. Looking back, I see that calligraphy taught me not only to write, but also to be (10)____.

passages.title: A Film About a Wood-carver
passages.text: Last week our class watched a (1)____ about a famous wood-carver. The film followed him for a whole (2)____ as he made a single screen by hand. We saw how he chose the wood with great (3)____, touching it and smelling it before cutting. Every tiny flower on the screen was carved with such (4)____ that it looked almost real. The artist said he had spent forty years (5)____ his skill, and he still practised every day. He never (6)____ to be famous; he simply loved his work. When the screen was finished, visitors were (7)____ by its beauty. The film ended with a clear (8)____: crafts like this must be passed on, or they will be (9)____ forever. After watching it, many of us felt a new (10)____ for the artists behind everyday objects.

a clear message 一个清晰的讯息。

passages.title: The Pottery Class
passages.text: Mia had always wanted to make things with her own (1)____, so she joined a pottery class in her town. Little by little, her hands learned to feel the right (6)____ and pressure. After many weeks, she finally made a small cup that did not (7)____ in the oven. She was so (8)____ that she nearly cried. The potter told her that every master had once been a (9)____ like her. From that day on, Mia understood that real skill is built through slow, (10)____ effort.

passages.title: A Handmade Gift
passages.text: For my mother's birthday, I decided to make a (1)____ instead of buying one. I spent two weeks knitting her a warm (2)____ by hand.
